subject: general
question: Ujjwala was the mascot of which national sports event held in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __Khelo India Para Games 2023__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ujjwala was the official mascot for the Khelo India Para Games 2023, symbolizing courage, determination, and the spirit of inclusivity.
 
• The Khelo India Para Games 2023 was organized to promote sports among differently-abled athletes and provide them with a national-level platform.
 
• The mascot Ujjwala represented inspiration, resilience, and the growing recognition of para-athletes in India.
 
• The games witnessed participation from para-athletes across different states and union territories in multiple sporting disciplines.
 
• The event aligned with the Khelo India initiative, which aims to strengthen sports culture and encourage equal opportunities in athletics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

__
 
• Khelo India Para Games:

 
 
• The Khelo India Para Games is a national multi-disciplinary sporting event for differently-abled athletes in India.
 
• It aims to encourage inclusivity and provide para-athletes with opportunities to compete at a high level.
 
• The event is conducted under the Khelo India programme initiated by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• The games help identify talented para-athletes for future national and international competitions.
 
 
 
• Ujjwala – The Mascot:
 
 
• The mascot Ujjwala, designed in the form of a flame, symbolizes strength, inspiration, and determination.
 
• It reflects the fighting spirit and dedication of para-athletes participating in the games.
 
• The name Ujjwala means "bright" or "radiant," signifying hope and empowerment through sports.
 
 
 
• Khelo India Programme:
 
 
• The Khelo India programme was launched in 2018 to promote sports culture at the grassroots level in India.
 
• It focuses on talent identification, infrastructure development, coaching, and financial support for athletes.
 
• The programme also emphasizes inclusivity by encouraging participation from para-athletes across the country.
 
 
 
• Importance of Para Sports:
 
 
• Para sports provide a platform for athletes with disabilities to demonstrate their abilities and achieve excellence.
 
• Events like the Khelo India Para Games help spread awareness about inclusivity and equal opportunities in sports.
 
• India has witnessed growing success in para sports at international events such as the Paralympics and Asian Para Games.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__

 
• Khelo India Youth Games:

 
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games is a separate event organized to nurture young sporting talent in India.
 
• It includes participation from school and college-level athletes in multiple disciplines.
 
 
 
• National Games:
 
 
• The National Games is a major multi-sport event organized among Indian states and union territories.
 
• It is conducted under the supervision of the Indian Olympic Association (IOA).
 
 
 
• Khelo India University Games:
 
 
• The Khelo India University Games promotes competitive sports among university students.
 
• It helps identify talented athletes at the collegiate level for future international representation.
